description: Land Title Settlement Department - Final Settlement Order No. 259 Matale in Dambulla District
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land settlement orders under the Land Settlement Ordinance, specifically addressing the final settlement of numerous land lots in the Matale District. It contains detailed schedules listing land parcels, their extents, and the parties (including The State and named individuals) on whom the lands are being settled. The content is primarily concerned with land registration, ownership, and title settlement matters, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes classification (Type 4).
